texte.Un système absent du registre ne coûte r: A system absent from the register costs nothing and weighs nothing in the tables, which does not mean it has no effect.
texte.Un système absent du registre sera absen: A system absent from the register will be absent from the risk assessment, and therefore absent from the Statement of Applicability. The omission propagates.
texte.Un système en conception n’a pas de volu: A system in design has no volume because it consumes nothing. Nothing to follow up here.
texte.Un système est à haut risque si : (#) il: A system is high-risk if: (#) it is a safety component of a product — or is itself a product — covered by the Annex I harmonisation legislation and subject to third-party conformity assessment (Art. #(#); assistance, optimisation, automation, comfort or quality-control functions unrelated to safety are not safety components, unless their failure endangers health or safety — #(#a) and #(#b)); or (#) it falls under one of the # areas of Annex III. Exception (#(#)): an Annex III system is not high-risk if it does not pose a significant risk — narrow procedural task, improvement of a human activity, detection of deviations, preparatory task — unless it performs profiling of natural persons, which is always high-risk.
texte.Un système présumé non conforme ne peut: A system presumed non-compliant cannot be placed on the market; where there is a risk, the provider and the market surveillance authorities are informed.
texte.Un tableau de bord de pilotage et les po: A steering dashboard and points of attention.
texte.Un taux de couverture bas n’est pas un r: A low coverage rate is not a reproach to the teams: it is a resource trade-off, and it is dealt with at your level.
texte.Un taux n'est PAS une conformité. Sur un: A rate is NOT compliance. On a legal obligation, an authority decides; on a certifiable standard, an accredited body; on a voluntary framework, nobody. Each card carries the sentence that says what # % does not mean, and it counts as much as the figure.
texte.Un taux n’est pas une conformité. Chaque: A rate is not compliance. Each card carries the sentence that says what # % does not mean, and it is that sentence you quote in committee, not the figure.
texte.Un tiret dans la colonne CRA n’est pas u: A dash in the CRA column is not a forgotten box: it means the Regulation says nothing about this module.
texte.Un tiret dans une colonne n’est pas un o: A dash in a column is not an oversight: it means the text says nothing about this module.
texte.Un usage déclaré n’est pas un usage obse: A declared use is not an observed use. The question to ask in a review is not “have you adopted it” but “show me the last time”.
texte.Un verrou ne retire pas des points, il p: A lock does not take points away, it sets a cap
texte.Un écart entre deux scénarios qui tient: A gap between two scenarios that falls within the uncertainty of the items is not a gap: look at the ranges before the totals.
texte.Un écart qui persiste après formation ne: A gap that persists after training is not corrected by one more course: it points to a tool poorly placed in the real work, or an access right that was never opened.
texte.Un écart « reprendre d'abord X dans #-#: A gap “first address X in #-#” is not scheduled on the OT side: it is a dependency, not a task.
texte.Un état des lieux structuré des principe: A structured review of the current state of the principles of Article #.
texte.Une AIPD est réalisée pour les traitemen: A DPIA is carried out for high-risk processing
texte.Une IA embarquée dans une machine de cha: AI embedded in a construction machine falls under Annex I of the AI Act via the Machinery Regulation. It is the most likely regulatory vehicle for this sector.
texte.Une IA intégrée à un équipement d'extrac: AI integrated into extraction equipment falls under Annex I of the AI Act via the Machinery Regulation: conformity assessment before placing on the market.
texte.Une TRAJECTOIRE au lieu d’un instantané: A TRAJECTORY instead of a snapshot — it is what an auditor asks for, and what an isolated score never shows.
texte.Une action à « +# » n’est pas inutile :: An action at “+#” is not useless: either it sets the direction of the points, or its gain is withheld by a blocker — and it is the blocker that needs treating, not the action.
texte.Une analyse d’impact RGPD déjà faite ne: A GDPR impact assessment already carried out does not count as a FRIA, and the reverse is also true: the two protect different things and are conducted separately.
texte.Une appréciation non refaite est le défa: An assessment that has not been redone is the most common defect at the first surveillance audit — the one where the effort was relaxed.
texte.Une association qui instruit l'éligibili: An association that examines eligibility for an essential social benefit on behalf of a local authority falls under Annex III, point #(a) — which covers systems used “by public authorities or on behalf of public authorities”. Delegation does not dilute the obligation, it moves it.
texte.Une autorité de contrôle demande la list: A supervisory authority asks for the list of people trained and the date, not the intention to train. Record completions as you go.
texte.Une autorité publique ou une institution: A public authority or Union institution deploying a high-risk system complies with the registration obligations of Article #; if the envisaged system is not registered there, it does not use it and informs the provider or the distributor.
texte.Une base de départ chiffrée, à reprendre: A quantified baseline, to be taken up again in six months — it is the gap between two measurements that proves a training plan has been of use.
texte.Une capture d’écran n’est pas une source: A screenshot is not a source: keep the link, the publisher and the date of consultation.
A mapping of the risks to be treated.
texte.Une clause absente ne se rattrape pas ap: A missing clause cannot be recovered after signature: the contract has to be reopened, and the provider has no interest in doing so.
texte.Une colonne « propriétaire » remplie ne: A filled-in “owner” column does not count as the dated acceptance that clause # e) requires. The auditor asks for the signature, not the name.
texte.Une comparaison n’est pas une équivalenc: A comparison is not an equivalence
texte.Une culture de conformité entretenue et: A compliance culture that is maintained and traceable.
texte.Une divergence normative est rarement un: A regulatory divergence is rarely a definitive obstacle: it is a cost and a delay. The useful question is by how much, not whether.
texte.Une décision ne vaut que par sa portée :: A decision is only worth its scope:
texte.Une déclaration signée sur un dossier in: A declaration signed on an incomplete file commits the person who signs it. This view says what remains open.
texte.Une entité essentielle peut être auditée: An essential entity can be audited without notice and without an incident. Evidence is kept up to date, not produced on demand.
texte.Une entité essentielle subit des audits: An essential entity is subject to ad hoc audits after a significant incident — it is written in Article #(#)(c).
texte.Une entité importante n’a pas à formalis: An important entity does not have to formalise this approach: the screen says so instead of displaying a zero that would be read as a failure.
texte.Une exclusion n’est recevable que si une: An exclusion is only admissible if a risk analysis shows
texte.Une exigence NON RENSEIGNÉE n’est pas un: A requirement that is NOT PROVIDED is not a compliant requirement. A rate calculated on three rows says nothing about the eighteen others — and it is that rate that gets shown in committee.
texte.Une exigence non renseignée n’est: A requirement that is not provided is not
texte.Une file vide ne signifie pas qu’aucun u: An empty queue does not mean that no use exists: it means that none has gone through the approval workflow.
texte.Une fois le terrain situé, chiffrez : en: Once the site is located, cost it: envelope, breakdown by DPGF lot, comparison between scenarios.
texte.Une grille de lecture extérieure sur un: An external reading grid on a subject that is always assessed optimistically in-house.
texte.Une hiérarchie des risques du projet fon: A hierarchy of the project’s risks based on dated and sourced facts, not on announcements.
texte.Une information claire est fournie aux p: Clear information is provided to data subjects
texte.Une lecture d’ensemble qui révèle les zo: An overall reading that reveals the areas of attention.
texte.Une liste courte de cas d’usage priorisé: A shortlist of prioritised and costed use cases, where the workshop had produced a long, flat list.
texte.Une liste opposable au vendeur, écrite a: A list you can hold the vendor to, written before the negotiation and not during it.
texte.Une liste priorisée et un dossier de val: A prioritised list and a costed business case, suitable for
A prioritised list and a business case.
texte.Une mesure non renseignée n’est pas une: A control that is not provided is not a compliant control. The number of empty rows is displayed next to the rate, on purpose.
texte.Une mesure retenue mais non mise en œuvr: A control that is included but not implemented covers nothing — and it is on the SoA that this shows.
texte.Une mesure taillée ne peut pas être plus: A tailored control cannot be stronger than the control it tailors. An axis declared above its family #-# is brought back down to it — and the overrun is FLAGGED. Lowering it silently would make the defect that needs showing disappear from the screen.
texte.Une mesure « touche » un risque ; elle n: A measure “touches” a risk; it does not close it. The bridge does not say otherwise.
texte.Une mesure écartée avec justification se: A control excluded with a justification can be defended; an empty box cannot. That holds in front of the auditor as much as in front of the authority.
texte.Une montée en compétence homogène plutôt: A uniform skills build-up rather than scattered knowledge depending on who has had the time to train.
texte.Une norme harmonisée citée au Journal of: A harmonised standard cited in the Official Journal and a common specification adopted by implementing act open a presumption of conformity: what remains is to document it. « Another standard » and « another technical solution » open none, and §# then calls for three more pieces — what is not covered, in writing, the justification of the choice, and objective evidence that the requirement is satisfied. The three boxes are there for that.
texte.Une organisation peut être parfaitement: An organisation can be perfectly compliant on a tool nobody opens. Generated by Sentinel AI.
texte.Une partie des articles trouve un répond: Some of the articles find a direct counterpart in Annex A: that much evidence already produced, and that much time that is not paid twice.
texte.Une personne nommée, qui accepte l’indis: A named person, who accepts the unavailability if it occurs.
texte.Une pièce qui survit à la réunion : c’es: A document that outlives the meeting: it is what will circulate internally at the prospect, once you are no longer there.
texte.Une plateforme de conformité qui ne s’ap: A compliance platform that does not apply to itself what it recommends is not credible. This page can be verified by the client: that is its purpose.
texte.Une procédure de retrait improvisée met: An improvised withdrawal procedure takes weeks. Written in advance, it takes days — and that is the difference the authority will look at.
texte.Une procédure permet l'accès, la rectifi: A procedure enables access, rectification and erasure
texte.Une proposition dont les extraits ne se: A proposal whose excerpts cannot be found word for word in your declaration is rejected before it is shown to you. If many end up as “to be completed”, the defect is in the register, not in the engine: it is the purposes that are missing.
texte.Une proposition qui porte ses hypothèses: A proposal that carries its assumptions and holds up in an investment committee, not only in a sales meeting.
texte.Une revue humaine purement formelle ne s: A purely formal human review is not enough.
texte.Une réponse rédigée par un modèle et pub: A response drafted by a model and published under the institution’s name falls under Article # as soon as it can pass for human.
texte.Une trace datée écrite pendant la crise: A dated trace written during the crisis is worth more than a reconstruction written afterwards. It takes two minutes, at the moment when nobody has any.
texte.Une vague # déclarée finie au jour du dé: A wave # declared finished on deployment day lets abandonment happen without a witness, and the programme ends on its best day.
texte.Une vision consolidée avant d’agir, et u: A consolidated view before acting, and an entry point to each module.
texte.Une vision consolidée pour décider, coût: A consolidated view for deciding, with costs to back it up.
texte.Une vision d’ensemble qu’aucun tableau E: An overall view that no scattered Excel spreadsheet can offer at this scale.
texte.Une vue synthétique immédiatement lisibl: A summary view that senior management can read immediately, without technical jargon.
texte.Une vérification non tracée est une véri: An untraced check is a check that did not take place, from an authority’s point of view.
texte.Une échéance anticipée est un arbitrage: A deadline anticipated is a trade-off; discovered late, it means reworking the file in a hurry.
texte.Une étape ne compte que si ce parcours v: A step only counts if this path led you to it — opening the same page from the menu does not advance a path you are not following.
texte.Une évaluation qui ne progresse pas d’un: An assessment that does not progress from one year to the next is a signal in itself: either the recommendations are not being followed, or they are not the right ones.
texte.Une évolution anticipée est un arbitrage: A change anticipated is a trade-off; discovered late, it means rework.
texte.Uploadez vos propres documents (politiqu: Upload your own documents (internal policies, contracts, procedures) to automatically enrich the Audit, AI register, FRIA and Maturity analyses with your real context, via semantic search.
texte.Usage innovant ou application de nouvell: Innovative use or application of new technologies
texte.Utile pour les cas sensibles de votre li: Useful for the sensitive cases on your shortlist.
texte.Utile pour les propositions commerciales: Useful for sales proposals: what is published today will be asked for in twelve months.
texte.Utilisez le bouton Simulateur depuis un: Use the Simulator button from a shortlisted case.
texte.Utilisez le filtre par rôle pour ne mont: Use the role filter to show teams only what really concerns them.
texte.Utilisez-la pour cadrer une discussion i: Use it to frame an internal discussion (budget, scope, contacts) before a sales conversation. Integration needs with the information system are what structure the project most: list them upfront.
texte.Valeurs codees en dur dans le JS (#, #,: Values hard-coded in the JS (#, #, #). To be updated manually if the published figures change.

texte.Validation clinique et explicabilite des: Clinical validation and explainability of AI recommendations
texte.Variable selon l'usage. Classifier avec: Varies with the use. Classify with the Simulator step by step.
texte.Veille momentanément indisponible. Réess: Watch temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
texte.Verification automatisee de l identite e: Automated verification of identity and documents at account opening.
texte.Verification des exceptions legales appl: Verification of the applicable legal exceptions before any deployment
texte.Verification des systemes de conduite as: Verification of assisted/autonomous driving systems before type approval, under strict regulatory control.
texte.Verifier l enregistrement dans la base U: Check registration in the EU database (Art. #, #)
texte.Version datée des référentiels employés: Dated version of the reference frameworks used (siting, footprint and data centres: #-#-a)
texte.Veuillez autoriser les fenêtres pour gén: Allow pop-ups to generate the report.
texte.Veuillez autoriser les pop-ups pour gene: Allow pop-ups to generate the report.

texte.Vidéoprotection assistée : hors identifi: Assisted video protection: outside biometric identification, you remain under the GDPR; as soon as you categorise on sensitive attributes, you enter Annex III, point #(b).
Twenty-four hours is a weekend. Delegation must exist beforehand, not be improvised.
texte.Virage dereglementaire (EO #, jan. #). F: Deregulatory turn (EO #, Jan. #). Fragmentation between federal states. Chip export controls as the main lever of international AI policy.
texte.Visualise # juridictions sur # critères: Displays # jurisdictions against # regulatory criteria (scope, penalties, transparency...), updated in real time by AI.
texte.Visualise votre posture sur # dimensions: Displays your posture on # regulatory dimensions, calculated from # systemic risks weighted by sector and by your actual AI register.
texte.Visualisez la répartition par service, p: View the breakdown by department, by legal basis, sensitive data and transfers.
texte.Visualisez l’exposition financière maxim: View the maximum financial exposure in the event of non-compliance.
texte.Visuels marketing générés, synthèse voca: Generated marketing visuals, speech synthesis, drafting of published content

texte.Voir ce qui est réellement déployé dans: See what is actually deployed in the EU
texte.Vos clients vont exiger le droit d’audit: Your clients will demand an unlimited right of audit and an exit strategy: anticipating them is better than discovering them in negotiation.
